en.s: The Battle on the Raxa river (German: Schlacht an der Raxa) was fought on 16 October 955 over control of the Billung march (in present-day Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, northeast Germany) between the forces of Otto I of Germany allied with the Rani tribe on one side, and the Obotrite federation under Nako and his brother Stoigniew (Stoinef, Stoinneg, Stoinegin, Ztoignav) with their allied and tributary Slav neighbours on the other.

zh.s: 拉克萨河战役（德语：Schlacht an der Raxa）于955年10月16日爆发，争夺比隆边区（今德国东北部梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州）的控制权。交战双方一边是德国国王奥托一世与拉尼人部族结盟的军队，另一边是纳科及其兄弟斯托伊格涅夫（也作斯托伊内夫、斯托因内格、斯托伊内金、兹托伊格纳夫）率领的奥博特里特联盟及其斯拉夫盟友和附属部族。

en.s: The Battle of Xiangyang (traditional Chinese: 襄陽之戰; simplified Chinese: 襄阳之战; pinyin: Xiāngyáng zhī zhàn) was a protracted series of battles between the Yuan dynasty and the Southern Song dynasty from 1267 to 1273. The battle was a significant victory for the Yuan dynasty and ended a 30-year defensive campaign waged by the Southern Song dynasty, allowing Yuan forces to advance into the Southern Song heartland.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 襄阳之战（繁体中文：襄陽之戰；简体中文：襄阳之战；拼音：Xiāngyáng zhī zhàn）是元朝与南宋之间一系列持续多年的战斗，时间为1267年至1273年。此战是元朝的一场重大胜利，结束了南宋持续30年的防御战役，使元军得以推进至南宋腹地。

en.s: The London uprising was a major event of the 1326 Invasion of England. Isabella of France, the wife of King Edward II, took the City of London, the principal city of the Kingdom of England, after her husband the King abandoned the Tower and fled to the west.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伦敦起义是1326年英格兰遭入侵期间的一场重要事件。法兰西的伊莎贝拉是英王爱德华二世的妻子；国王弃守伦敦塔并逃往西部后，她接管了伦敦城，也就是英格兰王国的主要城市。

en.t: Jadwiga is crowned ruler of Poland
en.s: On October 16, 1384, Jadwiga was crowned ruler of Poland in Kraków.

zh.t: 雅德维加加冕为波兰君主
zh.s: 1384年10月16日，雅德维加在克拉科夫加冕为波兰君主。

en.s: The 1555 Battle of Miyajima (厳島合戦, Itsukushima Kassen) was the only battle to be fought on the sacred island of Miyajima; the entire island is considered to be a Shinto shrine, and no birth or death is allowed on the island. Extensive purification rituals took place after the battle, to cleanse the shrine and the island of the pollution of death.

zh.s: 1555年的严岛之战（日语：厳島合戦，Itsukushima Kassen）是唯一一场在严岛这座圣岛上进行的战斗。整座岛被视为神道教神社，不允许在岛上出生或死亡。战后举行了大规模净化仪式，以清除死亡带来的污秽，净化神社和岛屿。

en.s: The Battle of Jiksan (직산 전투) was a military conflict fought between Ming and Japanese forces on 16 October 1597. It resulted in withdrawal by both sides. However the battle marked the furthest point the Japanese ever got to reaching Hanseong during the Second Invasion.

zh.s: 稷山之战（직산 전투）是明军与日军于1597年10月16日发生的一场军事冲突，双方最终都撤退。不过，这场战役标志着第二次入侵期间日军最接近汉城的一次。

en.s: The Battle at Jurjeve Stijene (Croatian: Bitka kod Jurjevih Stijena) was fought on 16 October 1663, at a canyon near Otočac in the Habsburg Kingdom of Croatia between the forces of Petar Zrinski, at the time captain of Senj, Ogulin and Primorje, and the forces of the Ottoman Empire under Ali-Pasha Čengić of the Eyalet of Bosnia.

zh.s: 尤尔耶韦岩战役（克罗地亚语：Bitka kod Jurjevih Stijena）于1663年10月16日在哈布斯堡王朝克罗地亚王国奥托查茨附近的一处峡谷爆发。交战双方是时任塞尼、奥古林和滨海地区指挥官彼得·兹林斯基率领的部队，以及波斯尼亚省总督阿里-帕夏·琴吉奇指挥的奥斯曼帝国军队。

en.s: The Battle of Podhajce (October 6–16, 1667) was fought in the town of Podhajce in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (nowadays Pidhaitsi, western Ukraine), and the area surrounding it as part of the Polish–Tatar War. The army of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth under John III Sobieski, totaling around 9,000 men, defeated Tatar and Cossack forces under Petro Doroshenko and Adil Giray, which totaled around 35,000 men.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波德海采战役于1667年10月6日至16日在波兰-立陶宛联邦的波德海采镇及周边地区进行，是波兰-鞑靼战争的一部分。扬三世·索别斯基率领约9,000名波兰-立陶宛联邦军队，击败了彼得罗·多罗申科和阿迪勒·格莱率领的鞑靼人与哥萨克军队，后者约有35,000人。

en.t: Battle of the Lake of Two Mountains
en.s: The Battle of the Lake of Two Mountains (French: Bataille du Lac-des-Deux-Montagnes) took place during the Beaver Wars between the colony of New France and the Haudenosaunee Confederacy that occurred on October 16, 1689. The battle occurred in response to the Lachine massacre of August 1689.

zh.s: 双山湖战役（法语：Bataille du Lac-des-Deux-Montagnes）于1689年10月16日爆发，是新法兰西殖民地与豪德诺索尼联盟在海狸战争期间的一场战斗。战役发生在1689年8月拉欣大屠杀之后。

en.s: The siege of Culloden House took place on the night of 15/16 October 1745 and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745. 200 men of the Jacobite Clan Fraser of Lovat attempted to capture Duncan Forbes, Lord Culloden who was the Lord President of the Court of Session, the most senior legal officer in Scotland.

zh.s: 卡洛登府围城战发生于1745年10月15日至16日夜间，是1745年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。200名弗雷泽氏族（洛瓦特支系）的詹姆斯党人试图抓获邓肯·福布斯勋爵。他当时是卡洛登勋爵，也是苏格兰最高法院院长、苏格兰最高司法官员。

en.s: The 1757 raid on Berlin took place during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). Cavalrymen of the Holy Roman Empire attacked and briefly occupied Berlin, the capital of Prussia. According to an apocryphal story General Hadik picked up gloves in Berlin for Empress Maria Theresa, but after leaving he realized that he got only gloves for her left hand.

zh.s: 1757年柏林突袭发生在第三次西里西亚战争期间（该战争是七年战争的一部分）。神圣罗马帝国的骑兵袭击并短暂占领了普鲁士首都柏林。一个未经证实的传说称，哈迪克将军在柏林为玛丽亚·特蕾莎女皇买了手套，但离开后才发现买到的全是她左手戴的手套。

en.t: British-led forces raid Royalton and nearby towns
en.s: On October 16, 1780, British-led forces attacked Royalton and nearby towns along the White River in what is now Vermont, United States, burning buildings and taking prisoners.

zh.t: 英国率领的部队袭击罗亚尔顿及附近城镇
zh.s: 1780年10月16日，英国率领的部队袭击白河沿岸的罗亚尔顿及附近城镇，焚毁建筑并掳走居民。这些地方位于今天美国的佛蒙特州。

en.s: The Great Hurricane of 1780 was the deadliest tropical cyclone in the Western Hemisphere. An estimated 22,000 people died throughout the Lesser Antilles when the storm passed through the islands from October 10 to October 16. Specifics on the hurricane's track and strength are unknown, as the official Atlantic hurricane database only goes back to 1851.
en.n: The Great Hurricane of 1780 finishes after its sixth day, killing between 20,000 and 24,000 residents of the Lesser Antilles.

zh.s: 1780年大飓风是西半球死亡人数最多的热带气旋。风暴于1780年10月10日至16日经过小安的列斯群岛，估计造成约22,000人死亡。由于官方大西洋飓风数据库只记录1851年以后的情况，风暴路径和强度的具体信息尚不清楚。
zh.n: 这条记录采用源资料信息框所列的结束日期。大飓风于第六天结束，造成小安的列斯群岛20,000至24,000名居民死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Wattignies (15–16 October 1793) saw a French army commanded by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan attack a Coalition army directed by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. After two days of combat Jourdan's troops compelled the Habsburg covering force led by François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt to withdraw. The War of the First Coalition victory allowed the French to raise the siege of Maubeuge.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓦蒂尼战役于1793年10月15日至16日进行。让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当指挥的法军进攻约西亚斯·萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德亲王率领的反法同盟军。经过两天战斗，法军迫使弗朗索瓦·塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦、克莱费特伯爵率领的哈布斯堡掩护部队撤退。这场反法同盟战争中的胜利使法军得以解除对莫伯日的围困。

en.s: The siege of Maubeuge (30 September – 16 October 1793) was a siege of the city of Maubeuge by an Austro-Dutch force of 60,000 men under Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld during the War of the First Coalition. Maubeuge was defended by a 24,000-strong garrison under the French Republican generals Desjardin and Mayer.

zh.s: 1793年9月30日至10月16日，约西亚斯·萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德亲王率领6万名奥地利和荷兰联军围攻莫伯日。守城的是由德雅尔丹和梅耶两位法兰西共和国将军指挥的24,000人驻军。此次围城战发生于第一次反法同盟战争期间。

en.t: Marie Antoinette is executed in Paris
en.s: On October 16, 1793, Marie Antoinette was executed by guillotine at the Place de la Révolution in Paris after being convicted by the Revolutionary Tribunal.

zh.t: 玛丽·安托瓦内特在巴黎被处决
zh.s: 1793年10月16日，玛丽·安托瓦内特被革命法庭判罪后，在巴黎革命广场被送上断头台。

en.s: The Battle of Ulm on 16–20 October 1805 was a series of skirmishes, at the end of the Ulm campaign, which allowed Napoleon I to trap an entire Austrian army under the command of Karl Freiherr Mack von Leiberich with minimal losses and to force its surrender near Ulm in the Electorate of Bavaria.

zh.s: 1805年10月16日至20日的乌尔姆战役是一系列小规模交战，也是乌尔姆战役行动的最后阶段。拿破仑一世以较小损失包围了卡尔·弗赖赫尔·马克·冯·莱贝里希指挥的整支奥地利军队，并迫使其在巴伐利亚选侯国乌尔姆附近投降。

en.s: In the Capitulation of Erfurt on 16 October 1806, a large body of troops from the Kingdom of Prussia under Lieutenant General the Prince of Orange surrendered to Marshal Joachim Murat of France, at the city of Erfurt (now in Germany). The Prussian soldiers were demoralized by their shattering defeat at the Battle of Jena–Auerstedt on 14 October and unwilling to put up much resistance.

zh.s: 1806年10月16日，普鲁士王国奥兰治亲王、陆军中将率领的一支大军在埃尔福特向法国元帅约阿希姆·缪拉投降。埃尔福特现位于德国。普鲁士军队在10月14日耶拿-奥尔施泰特战役惨败后士气低落，也不愿进行顽强抵抗。

en.s: The Battle of Leipzig, also known as the Battle of the Nations, was fought from 16 to 19 October 1813 at Leipzig, Saxony. The Coalition armies of Austria, Prussia, Sweden, and Russia, led by Tsar Alexander I, Karl von Schwarzenberg, Gebhard von Blücher and Swedish Crown Prince Charles John, decisively defeated the Grande Armée of French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱比锡战役又称民族会战，于1813年10月16日至19日在萨克森的莱比锡进行。沙皇亚历山大一世、卡尔·冯·施瓦岑贝格、格布哈德·冯·布吕歇尔和瑞典王储卡尔·约翰领导的奥地利、普鲁士、瑞典及俄罗斯同盟军，决定性地击败了法国皇帝拿破仑·波拿巴的大军团。

en.s: The Battle of Doro Passage was a naval engagement during the United States Navy's operation against Greek pirates in the Aegean Sea. On October 16, 1827 a British merchant ship was attacked by pirates in Doro Passage off the islands of Andros and Negroponte but was retaken by American sailors.

zh.s: 多罗海峡战斗是美国海军在爱琴海打击希腊海盗行动中的一次海战。1827年10月16日，一艘英国商船在安德罗斯岛和内格罗蓬特岛附近的多罗海峡遭海盗袭击，后被美国水兵夺回。

en.s: The Palace of Westminster, the medieval royal palace used as the home of the British parliament, was largely destroyed by fire on 16 October 1834. The blaze was caused by the burning of small wooden tally sticks which had been used as part of the accounting procedures of the Exchequer until 1826.

zh.s: 1834年10月16日，曾作为英国议会所在地的中世纪王宫威斯敏斯特宫大部分被大火烧毁。火灾由小木制计数棒燃烧引起；财政署在1826年前一直将这些计数棒用于会计工作。

en.s: The Battle of Vegkop, alternatively spelled as Vechtkop, took place on 16 October 1836 near the present day town of Heilbron, Free State, South Africa. After an impi of about 600 Matebele murdered 15 to 17 Afrikaner voortrekkers on the Vaal River, abducting three children, King Mzilikazi (c. 1790 – 9 September 1868; also known as Mzilikazi, Oemsiligasi or Moselekatse; Afrikaans: Silkaats) ordered another attack. The Voortrekkers, under the command of Andries Potgieter, repulsed them, but at the cost of abandoning their livestock.

zh.s: 韦格科普战役于1836年10月16日在今南非自由州海尔布隆附近爆发。约600名马特贝莱军人组成的部族武装曾在瓦尔河杀害15至17名布尔先民，并绑走3名儿童。国王姆齐利卡齐随后下令再次进攻。安德里斯·波特吉特率领的布尔先民击退了来袭部队，但被迫放弃牲畜。

en.s: On October 16, 1841, a royal charter established Queen’s College at Kingston, now Queen’s University in Canada.

zh.t: 金斯顿女王学院获得皇家特许状

en.s: In 1858, the United States Navy launched an operation on the island of Waya in Fiji following the death of two American traders there. The Pacific Squadron executed a punitive expedition against the native warriors of Seru Epenisa Cakobau and defeated them in a pitched battle at the village of Somatti.

en.t: John Brown begins his raid on Harpers Ferry
en.s: On the night of October 16, 1859, abolitionist John Brown led a raid on the federal armory at Harpers Ferry, then in Virginia and now in West Virginia, hoping to start an uprising against slavery.

zh.t: 约翰·布朗发动哈珀斯费里突袭
zh.s: 1859年10月16日晚，废奴主义者约翰·布朗率人突袭哈珀斯费里的联邦军械库，希望引发反抗奴隶制的起义。当地当时属于弗吉尼亚州，现属西弗吉尼亚州。

en.s: The Battle of Bolivar Heights (October 16, 1861) was an early battle of the American Civil War. Bolivar Heights is a plateau which overlooks the towns of Harpers Ferry, West Virginia and Bolivar, West Virginia, then part of Virginia. On October 15, 1861, Union Major General Nathaniel P. Banks ordered Colonel John White Geary to cross the Potomac River from Maryland Heights, part of Elk Ridge (Maryland) and capture wheat stored by the Confederate States Army near Bolivar Heights. Geary crossed the river with 600 men but sent 500 of them back that night.

zh.s: 博利瓦尔高地战役于1861年10月16日爆发，是美国内战初期的一场战斗。博利瓦尔高地是一处高地，可俯瞰当时属于弗吉尼亚州的哈珀斯费里镇和博利瓦尔镇。1861年10月15日，联邦军少将纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯命令约翰·怀特·吉里上校从马里兰高地（属马里兰州埃尔克岭）渡过波托马克河，夺取邦联军储存在博利瓦尔高地附近的小麦。吉里率领600人渡河，但当晚又让其中500人返回。

en.s: The Affair at Glenmore Farm was a small cavalry skirmish that took place October 16, 1862, in Loudoun County, Virginia, between Confederate forces under First Lieutenant Frank Myers and Union forces under General John Geary during the American Civil War. The skirmish resulted in a Union victory.

zh.s: 格伦莫尔农场事件是美国内战期间的一场小规模骑兵交战，于1862年10月16日在弗吉尼亚州劳登县发生。交战双方是弗兰克·迈尔斯中尉指挥的邦联军和约翰·吉里将军指挥的联邦军，最终联邦军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Brooke was a minor engagement fought October 16–18, 1863, near Tampa, Florida, during the American Civil War.

en.t: The College for Women opens in Hitchin
en.s: On October 16, 1869, five students began the first term at the College for Women at Benslow House in Hitchin, England. The college later became Girton College, Cambridge.

zh.t: 剑桥格顿学院的前身在欣钦开课
zh.s: 1869年10月16日，五名学生在英格兰欣钦本斯洛庄园的女子学院开始第一学期的学习。这所学院后来成为剑桥大学的格顿学院。

en.t: Northern front of the Battle of Transylvania
en.s: On 27 August 1916, Romania entered World War I on the side of the Allies, three of its armies invading Transylvania. en.s: The Battle of Mosul (Arabic: معركة الموصل, Ma'rakat al-Mawṣil) was a major battle initiated by Iraq and allied forces to retake the city of Mosul from the Islamic State (IS), which had seized the city years prior in June 2014. It was the largest conventional land battle in the world since the capture of Baghdad in 2003. It was also the world's single largest military operation overall since the 2003 invasion of Iraq and was considered the toughest urban battle since World War II. The operation, which was called Operation "We Are Coming, Nineveh" (قادمون يا نينوى; Qadimun Ya Naynawa), began on 16 October 2016, with forces besieging ISIL-controlled areas in the Nineveh Governorate surrounding Mosul, and continued with Iraqi troops and Peshmerga fighters engaging ISIL on three fronts outside Mosul, going from village to village in the surrounding area in the largest deployment of Iraqi troops since the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

zh.s: 摩苏尔战役是伊拉克及其盟军为从伊斯兰国（IS）手中夺回摩苏尔而发起的一场重要战役。伊斯兰国此前于2014年6月夺取该城。这是自2003年攻占巴格达以来全球规模最大的常规地面战役，也是自2003年入侵伊拉克以来规模最大的单次军事行动，并被视为二战以来最艰难的城市战。行动名为“我们来了，尼尼微”（阿拉伯语：قادمون يا نينوى；Qadimun Ya Naynawa），于2016年10月16日开始。部队包围尼尼微省摩苏尔周边由伊斯兰国控制的地区；伊拉克军队和佩什梅格武装随后从城外三条战线与伊斯兰国交战，逐村推进。这是自2003年入侵以来伊拉克部署规模最大的军队。

en.s: The 60th New York Film Festival took place from September 30 to October 16, 2022, in New York City, presented by Film at Lincoln Center. Noah Baumbach's absurdist comedy-drama White Noise was selected as the "Opening Night Film" for this edition. Laura Poitras' documentary All the Beauty and the Bloodshed was chosen as NYFF's "Centerpiece Film", James Gray's drama film Armageddon Time was selected as NYFF's 60th anniversary celebration film.

en.s: The Battle of Kurakhove was a battle for control of the city of Kurakhove and the surrounding area between the Russian Armed Forces and the Ukrainian Armed Forces. The battle for the city began on 16 October 2024, when Russian forces' offensive operation in the direction of Kurakhove succeeded in capturing the nearby settlement of Ostrivske on 15 October, thus beginning the battle as Russian forces entered the administrative limits of the city from the north-eastern direction on the eastern bank of the Kurakhove reservoir.

zh.s: 库拉霍沃战役是俄罗斯武装部队与乌克兰武装部队为争夺库拉霍沃市及周边地区而进行的战斗。2024年10月16日，俄军向库拉霍沃方向发动的攻势成功占领附近的奥斯特里夫斯克定居点（该地于10月15日被攻占），战役由此开始。俄军随后从库拉霍沃水库东岸的东北方向进入该市行政边界。
